name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
summary: In Desolace, Leftwitch's list sends Kreldig Ungor after scorpashi venom and aged kodo hides. He barely knows the land and cannot point you toward either creature.

sections.title: The Next Items
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor reaches the next items on Leftwitch's list. She asks for seven vials of venom from any scorpashi and three hides from aged kodo. Dying and ancient kodo will not do. The instructions are plain, though Kreldig muses that mages ask for odd things.

sections.title: Unfamiliar Ground
sections.body: Kreldig cannot tell you where the kodo or scorpashi roam. He barely knows Desolace and has had no time to explore it.

faq.answer: Leftwitch, a mage, made the list Kreldig Ungor is working through.

faq.q: Why does Kreldig need help finding these creatures?
faq.answer: Kreldig barely knows Desolace and has had no time to explore it, so he cannot say where the kodo or scorpashi roam.

faq.q: Can hides from any kodo be used?
faq.answer: No. Leftwitch asks for aged kodo hides. Dying and ancient kodo do not count.
Scorpashi are scorpions found throughout Desolace. Leftwitch says venom from any of them will do.

faq.q: Where do the aged kodo roam?
faq.answer: Aged kodo follow the trails, chiefly in the south and west. Many end up near the Kodo Graveyard.
